summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Knowledge Centre (Blogs) feature. 21/21 backend pytest cases pass (list, pagination, search, slug, related, admin login/verify, CRUD, include_unpublished auth gating, image upload roundtrip, _id leak checks). Frontend e2e covered public /knowledge-centre hero + grid (5 seed cards), BlogPost detail with sidebar search (matched + 'No results'), /blogs -> /knowledge-centre redirect, 404 blog-not-found state, admin login (wrong + correct password), admin dashboard listing with publish toggle, New Blog creation via TipTap editor (title/author/category/tags/summary/featured URL/body), edit-load persistence, and delete with confirm. ChromeWrapper correctly hides Header/Footer on /admin routes and shows them on public routes. 'Knowledge Centre' link is present in main nav.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 218: authorization.split()[-1] without length-check on empty string works only because empty split() returns []; acceptable but consider using the require_admin parser to avoid duplication.

GET /api/blogs/{blog_id} is guarded by require_admin but the route ordering (/blogs/slug/{slug} and /blogs/related/{slug} are defined before) is correct; still, future /blogs/<something> public endpoints must be registered before this protected generic one to avoid 401 on public URLs.
No server-side file-size limit on /api/admin/upload (only extension check). Consider adding a max size to avoid abuse.
TipTap contenteditable lacks a data-testid which made automated input slightly brittle; adding data-testid='admin-form-content' on the editor root would help future tests.

AdminBlogs page polls blogs via GET /api/blogs?include_unpublished=true but only redirects to /admin/login on 401 response. If API returns empty items due to any other error, the admin sees an empty table silently; consider adding a surfaced error state.
seed_data_creation: Tests created transient TEST_-prefixed blogs and cleaned them up. A temporary E2E blog was created via UI and then deleted, leaving DB in original 5-seed state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_blogs_api.py covers all blog APIs including ObjectId leak checks and upload roundtrip. Frontend flows verified against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin token = password ('ReCircle@2026') stored in localStorage key 'recircle_admin_token'. TipTap editor root is '.ProseMirror' contenteditable (no data-testid yet).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Two transient console 500 errors during browser automation were unrelated to the Knowledge Centre APIs (verified via curl: /api/blogs, /api/blogs/related/<unknown>, /api/blogs/slug/<unknown> respond with expected 200/404).
